OUTSTANDING TEENAGERS FEATURED IN AMPAIGN PROMOTION 


esses SS SS S-S>= => SS SS SSS SS SSS sss = SS ee SSS 


Two teenage members of the International Branch of the Y.M.C.A. 


served as models for this year's publicity program. 


Mary Lou Interlino started ballet at the Y at age ) and has held 
continuous membership since. She is a member of the Intermediate 
Leader Corps and is an accomplished swimmer and gymnast. As a 
volunteer leader Mary Lou teaches swimming to tiny tots on 

Fridays and is a volunteer arts and crafts instructor on 

Saturdays. Her mother is ballet mistress and ladies gym instructor 


at International Y. 


Don Page, former president of the leaders corps was voted out- 
standing youth leader in 1963. He is a graduate of the National 
Y.1.C.A. leader training program having attended three summer 
courses at Geneva Park Ontario. Don is an accomplished gymnast 
and swimmer and gives swimming instructions to younger members 
as a volunteer. His mother is also active as secretary of the 
local Y's youth committee. Don plans on a Y.M.C.A. career 


following graduation.
